packageRules.description: Pinned by a replace directive to the v2.0.0-beta4 commit. The tag declares no /v2 module path, so Go resolves it to a pseudo-version that sorts below the v1.29x releases; any bump would silently move the provider onto the terraform-plugin-sdk v1 code line, which cannot build under the no-fork architecture. Unpin once upstream ships v2.0.0 with a /v2 module path.
